svg.aria-label: Industrial equipment publishes raw Protobuf directly to Azure Event Hubs. A custom SMT on Confluent Cloud's Azure Event Hubs Source connector schema-tags each record by embedding its Protobuf schema ID directly in the payload, and routes it to the matching topic, making a native non-Confluent producer fully schema-registry compatible with no producer-side changes. Downstream Snowflake analytics is architecture context only, not implemented here.
svg.text: Native Protobuf from Azure Event Hubs, schema-tagged into Confluent Cloud
one ID baked in per topic
A custom SMT schema-tags each record by embedding its Protobuf schema ID directly in the payload (not a header) and routes it to the matching topic — no changes to the producer.
